scores.name: Justin Tyme
scores.reason: He placed recovered bottle, now identified as toxic stolen original, and handled target glass. His empty-copy account is wrong; contaminated miniature and neck fragment imply transfer, though someone could have left original loose before his photography.

assessment.why: A defensible but provisional accusation: Justin admits placing the exact original at recovery site and touching the poisoned glass while claiming an empty copy. Others could have swapped the loose bottle, and the transfer miniature has no name.

plausibility_notes: Empty photographs permit a small residue or dose before filling; they do not continuously establish when contamination occurred. Common favor label is properly non-identifying.
